title: Guild Wars 3
premise: Guild Wars 3 is an MMORPG developed by ArenaNet. As a Gameplay Engineer Intern, I owned early iterations of critical gameplay mechanics and worked on multiplayer replication.
description: As a Gameplay Engineer Intern at ArenaNet, I owned the first iterations of critical gameplay mechanics for Guild Wars 3, such as equipment systems and metahuman-gameplay integration. I built gameplay prototypes in Unreal C++ dealing heavily with multiplayer replication.

screenshots.comment: Busy town square with NPCs and players

title: Earthward

screenshots.comment: Procedural World Generation tool in Unity

premise: A multiplayer RPG about exploring underground worlds, crafting equipment, and reclaiming the surface. I developed the game in Unity, including terrain streaming and networking for 10+ players.
description: I developed Earthward in Unity, with Steam networking for 10+ players. I built procedural terrain generation, per-player chunk streaming, and on-demand generation of unexplored regions. Terrain edits and world objects persist through unloading and save restoration. My work also covers combat, mining and placement, water simulation, inventory, and equipment systems. I developed procedural terrain meshes, a custom pixel-lighting pipeline, HLSL effects, and editor tools for authoring world content.

title: Midnight Delivery

screenshots.comment: Data-table driven quest and dialogue system
Toon outline shader and depth-based water

premise: An adventure game built in Unreal Engine. I served as Tech Lead and Content Designer, working on quests, gameplay systems, shaders, and the build pipeline.
description: As Tech Lead and Content Designer, I developed a data-table-driven quest and dialogue system in Unreal Engine. I designed quests and events, implemented physics features, and worked on potion crafting with inventory management. My rendering work included toon outlines and depth-based water shaders. I maintained the Jenkins CI/CD pipeline for project builds.

title: Bitlands

screenshots.comment: Badge collection, serialized and linked to Steam achievements

premise: A 2D action platformer about overthrowing a corrupt king in a war-torn world. I developed the game solo in GameMaker and released it on Steam.
description: As the sole developer, I built Bitlands in GameMaker and released it on Steam. I implemented the gameplay systems and designed the levels, including Crystal Caverns. I developed a badge collection system with serialized progress and Steam achievement integration. My responsibilities covered development through the Steam release.

title: Lilypad Lowdown
premise: A game jam action game about a frog protecting her children from a toad army. I programmed gameplay, combat, and progression systems.
description: I programmed gameplay, combat, and progression systems for Lilypad Lowdown during a game jam. The game follows a frog fighting through a toad army to protect her children. I implemented the gameplay logic, fixed bugs, and refined player interactions within the jam deadline.

title: Daisy's Quest
premise: A game jam puzzle game where your corpse becomes a platform. I programmed the gameplay and puzzle mechanics.
description: I programmed gameplay and puzzle logic for Daisy's Quest during a game jam. Its puzzles use the player's corpse as a platform, making death part of traversal. I implemented the interactions behind the puzzles, then fixed bugs and refined the game logic before submission.

title: Koko: The Last Leaf
premise: A fantasy metroidvania following the last of the leaf kind through a world of gods and magic. I composed the soundtrack.
description: I composed the soundtrack for Koko: The Last Leaf, a fantasy metroidvania released on Steam. I wrote music for exploration and combat, supporting the game's setting and pacing through the soundtrack.

title: Fresh Fruits
premise: A dungeon crawler about an avocado escaping a supermarket through procedurally generated rooms. I contributed programming, art, and music.
description: I contributed gameplay programming, visual assets, and music to Fresh Fruits, a dungeon crawler developed in Lynx Engine. The game uses procedurally generated rooms and unlockable abilities. My role covered code, art production, and composition within the same project.

title: Paradigm
premise: A puzzle adventure where players create copies of themselves to navigate a hostile world. I composed the soundtrack.
description: I composed the soundtrack for Paradigm, a puzzle adventure centered on creating copies of the player character. I wrote music to accompany its environments and puzzle sequences, supporting the game's atmosphere and pacing.

title: Seashore Siege
premise: A tower defense game about protecting a sandcastle from sea creatures. I programmed gameplay systems and the core game loop.
description: I implemented gameplay systems and the core game loop for Seashore Siege, a tower defense prototype. Players collect sand dollars to place towers and defend a sandcastle against sea creatures. I also fixed bugs and refined player interactions during development.

title: Glow Engine

screenshots.comment: Snippet of a custom .obj model parser (C++)

premise: A custom 3D engine built in C++ with DirectX 11. I developed its rendering, editor tools, physics, and component systems.
description: I developed Glow Engine in C++ with DirectX 11, implementing rendering, model loading, component serialization, collision detection, and physics. I built an ImGui editor with scene editing, an inspector, resource browsing, settings, and a console. The engine also supports point lights and scene creation.

title: Earth Engine

screenshots.comment: Top-down demo project developed in Earth Engine

premise: A cross-platform 2D engine built in C# with MonoGame. I developed its runtime, rendering pipeline, and ImGui.NET editor.
description: I developed Earth Engine in C# with MonoGame, using an entity-component-system architecture. I built a 2D renderer with sprite batching, layered rendering, dynamic lighting, particles, and post-processing shaders. The ImGui.NET editor supports entity inspection, component editing, scene management, and debug visualization. The runtime supports Windows, Linux, and macOS.

title: Lynx Engine
premise: A 2D engine developed by a seven-person team and used to build Fresh Fruits. I contributed as a graphics programmer.
description: As a graphics programmer on a seven-person team, I contributed to Lynx Engine's rendering systems and graphics pipeline. The 2D engine supports shaders, ImGui tooling, level serialization, physics, and gameplay components. It was used to develop Fresh Fruits.

title: Graphics Engine
premise: A DirectX 11 graphics engine with procedural geometry and point lighting. I implemented the geometry generation and rendering.
description: I developed a DirectX 11 graphics engine with procedural 3D geometry generation and point-light rendering. My work covered creating mesh vertices and implementing the lighting used to render the generated objects.

title: Room Editor
premise: A visual tool for creating tile-based rooms for procedural worlds. I built its editing interface, layer tools, and JSON export.
description: I developed a level editor for authoring rooms used in chunk-based world generation. It supports imported tilesets, tile and object layers, instance properties, and layer visibility controls. I implemented JSON export so authored rooms can be loaded by the game, along with room saving, loading, pan, and zoom controls.

title: Behavior Tree Editor
premise: A visual editor for authoring enemy AI in GameMaker. I developed the node interface, execution ordering, and export pipeline.
description: I developed a visual editor for authoring enemy AI in GameMaker. I implemented node connections, execution ordering, and an export pipeline. The node library includes selectors, sequences, parallel nodes, decorators, and gameplay conditions such as line of sight and grounded state.

title: Earth Edit
premise: A schema-driven editor for items, enemies, and other game content. I built the C# application and its JSON editing workflow.
description: I developed a C# editor for authoring data-driven game content for Earthward. Schemas define typed fields, defaults, and enumeration options for content such as items and enemies. I built the editing interface and JSON export workflow, including presets for combat stats, animation data, and loot references.

title: Budget Master
premise: A .NET/WPF application for tracking spending and managing budgets. I developed the application and its visual reports.
description: I developed Budget Master as a .NET/WPF budgeting application. My work covered spending tracking, budget management, and visual reports, from the data flow through the application interface.

title: Kira AI Agent
premise: An AI assistant application with automation and contextual responses. I developed its behavior and application logic.
description: I developed an AI assistant application with automation and contextual responses. My responsibilities included the assistant's behavior, interaction flow, and application logic, connecting the AI features to the surrounding user interface.

title: Portfolio
premise: A portfolio for my games, engines, and development tools. I designed and built the site with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
description: I designed and developed this portfolio with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I built the project carousels, screenshot viewer, video previews, and direct links to individual projects. The homepage and Projects page load their content from shared JSON data. I also implemented responsive layouts, navigation, and the contact form.

title: Archery Overhaul
premise: A Terraria mod that expands ranged combat with new weapons, equipment, and mechanics. I developed the content and gameplay systems.
description: I developed a Terraria mod that expands ranged combat with bows, arrows, crossbows, accessories, and progression systems. Features include alternate crossbow attacks, equipped quiver visuals, custom arrow impact effects, and critical-hit shockwaves. I also worked on recipes, materials, loot, and NPC content.

title: Spear Overhaul
premise: A Terraria mod that expands the spear subclass with new weapons and progression. I designed and implemented the added content.
description: I developed a Terraria mod that expands the spear subclass with new weapons, attack behaviors, and supporting gear. My work covered item implementation, progression design, and balance across the added weapons and equipment.

title: Sorcery Overhaul
premise: A Terraria mod that expands mage progression with new equipment and mana mechanics. I designed and implemented its content and systems.
description: I developed a Terraria mod that expands mage progression with magic weapons, armor sets, and mana mechanics. I designed and implemented the added content, its progression structure, and the systems behind its combat behavior.

title: Riptide's Mod
premise: A Terraria mod containing examples for my tModLoader tutorial series. I developed the source examples and recorded implementation walkthroughs.
description: I developed example Terraria mod content for a tModLoader tutorial series. The repository covers weapons, tools, blocks, world generation, sound, and projectiles. I structured the examples for learners and produced video walkthroughs of the implementation.
